declared_protocol.resource_pause_policy: hold existing manual pause; stop first observed pause; no resume or retry
declared_protocol.model_reset_policy: fresh model and app process for every slot; no OS page-cache flush; within-case KV caching uses normal server defaults
declared_protocol.warmup_policy: llama-server default startup warmup; no doctor/chat/load-probe generation before submission
declared_protocol.ordering: manifest case order; baseline then adaptive for even case index, adaptive then baseline for odd case index
declared_protocol.attempt_policy: exactly one scheduled attempt per case/variant; preflight or submission failures consume a slot and remain in the accounting ledger; no replacement attempt
declared_protocol.infrastructure_policy: stop remaining schedule on model OOM/restart, unconfirmed cleanup, unknown running work, or unsafe starting resources; remaining slots explicitly unattempted
declared_protocol.comparison_scope: all 12 fixed synthetic tasks, 8 development and 4 heldout; 24 slots; measurement comparability is separate from output delivery and successful outcomes
declared_protocol.quality_scope: lexical, retrieval and citation-ownership proxies only; report partial-text populations separately; no heldout tuning

provenance.historical_hash_attestation_limit: Current file hashes and captured launch/config records; not retroactive file-content attestation for every process.
